90050953|*--.name: All In the Wrist
90050953|*--.tooltipDescription: Increases attack speed by 30%.\n\n<font color="#FFD400">To properly motivate her henchmen, Madria added a lightning sharp snap to the flick of her wrist, creating an effective, high speed attack.</font>

90050954|*--.name: Blessing of Punctuality
90050954|*--.tooltipDescription: Increases movement speed by 25%. \n\n<font color="#FFD400">A dark aura lightens the body, allowing faster movement. Madria used this whenever she was late for a meeting, which was often.</font>

90050955|*--.name: Toying with Gods: Rage
90050955|*--.tooltipDescription: All attacks become critical.\n\n<font color="#FFD400">When Madria's mad, watch out! That even one of her trinkets possess this much power reveals how deadly she truly is.</font>

90050956|*--.name: Black Steel Polish
90050956|*--.tooltipDescription: Increases physical and magic resistance by 540. \n\n<font color="#FFD400">The magic coating this armor is the same as the kind used on Madria's castle walls.</font>

90050957|*--.name: Eternal Fitness
90050957|*--.tooltipDescription: Completely restores stamina every 5 sec.\n\n<font color="#FFD400">Quickens metabolism, restoring energy faster than usual. This enabled Madria to keep a close eye on all parts of her domain.</font>

90050958|*--.name: Monarch's Treatment
90050958|*--.tooltipDescription: Recovers 330 health every sec.\n\n<font color="#FFD400">A dark magic treatment that heals injuries. Madria used this magic on her henchmen far more than she used it on herself.</font>

90050959|*--.name: Giant Monarch
90050959|*--.tooltipDescription:
Turns you into a giant, and increases physical and magic attack by 48%. 

<font color="#FFD400">Madria was trying to make herself grow older and discarded this spell when it made her grow bigger instead. 
A larger body means more muscle mass, which means more combat ability.</font>

90050960|*--.name: Mini Monarch
90050960|*--.tooltipDescription:
Shrinks, and increases all damage by 72%.

<font color="#FFD400">Madria intended to use this spell to make herself look like a 10-year-old, then realized that she already did, so she ditched it. 
With a smaller body, it's easier to sneak past enemy defense, which enhances combat ability.</font>

90050961|*--.name: Party Dance
90050961|*--.tooltipDescription: You can dance if you want to. And even if you don't.\n\n<font color="#FFD400">Madria whips out this terrifying magic at parties, forcing people to dance until they collapse. Her henchman categorize this magic as a form of torture, but it's not certain that's what she intended.</font>

90050964|*--.name: Materialized Rage
90050964|*--.tooltipDescription: Chance of dealing 24% additional damage on hit.\n\n<font color="#FFD400">Magic in the form of materialized rage is said to be impossible, yet Madria is able to control this type of magic at will.</font>

90050966|*--.name: Shadow Phase Shift
90050966|*--.tooltipDescription: Increases evasion and all damage by 50%.\n\n<font color="#FFD400">The true form of this ornament cannot be seen with the naked eye.</font>

90050967|*--.name: Black Iron Reflective
90050967|*--.tooltipDescription: Absorbs damage equivalent to 5% of health. Increases all damage by 80% when this effect is active.\n\n<font color="#FFD400">This magic is the same as the one used on Madria's castle walls. She created it to win a wrestling match against Lukarax.</font>

90050968|*--.name: I Think. Therefore, I Hunt.
90050968|*--.tooltipDescription: Increases monster slaying experience by 20%.\n\n<font color="#FFD400">Madria created this magic to help her stay focused when she trained, so that she could become one of the Seven Commanders. She could easily have overcome the spell with a single thought, but a normal person would've been totally enthralled by the drive to gain more and more experience.</font>

90050969|*--.name: Nervous System Overload
90050969|*--.tooltipDescription: Increases movement speed, all damage, and attack speed by 50%, but inverts movement.\n\n<font color="#FFD400">This magic enhances your senses, granting a wealth of abilities, but due to a slight miscalculation on Madria's part, it also flips the nervous system. Due to that, it's become a rather inferior spell.</font>

90050970|*--.name: Lavish Lifestyle
90050970|*--.tooltipDescription: Increases fishing and performance experience by 700%. This skill will not enhance experience past 700%. \n\n<font color="#FFD400">With this magic, anyone can live the lavish life of leisure that Madria enjoys, even if it's just for a short time.</font>

90050971|*--.name: Monarch's Incessant Poking
90050971|*--.tooltipDescription: Increases damage taken by the target by 5% for 1 sec on hit.\n\n<font color="#FFD400">Madria has a philosophy: keep whacking on the same spot, and it'll really start to hurt. This magic is a reflection of that.</font>
